root_causes: The measurement validator rejected valid string measurements such as service names and timestamps.
Some structured evidence values were JSON-stringified by the model.
The Judge lacked a concise list of allowed evidence fields and values.
The model’s redundant evidence ID list sometimes differed from the IDs in its valid field citations.
fixes: Strictly validate measurement JSON types while allowing exact authoritative strings.
Constrain the measurement schema to the exact authoritative map.
Provide a citeable field/value catalog and exact-value instructions.
Canonicalize JSON-stringified arrays/objects only after exact type-sensitive equality with stored data.
Keep unsupported or missing facts out of decisive-fact entries and derive evidence references from validated citations.
Retry transient Google transport failures up to three bounded attempts.
gemini_output_investigation.validation: The final full benchmark completed all 120 cases with zero invalid citations, provider errors, or fallbacks. The 20 cases that previously encountered transport failures also passed a separate targeted retry smoke.
